parameters.name: sessionId
parameters.description: A longer identifier than 128 characters is 404, like an unknown one.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated UUID per logical submit, 1-128 printable ASCII characters. A repeat of the same method, path and body replays the stored answer (response header Idempotency-Replayed: true) when that answer was a 2xx or a refusal that is final or committed state; a refusal a retry can pass, and every 5xx, is not stored: the key is released and the same request runs again. The same key on a different request whose answer was stored is 409 idempotency-key-reused.
